# redirhub_links (Data Source)

The workspace's links, newest first, narrowed by the filters of `GET /v1/links`. Useful to find links made in the dashboard before importing them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The redirects on a domain, e.g. to find the ids of links made in the dashboard before importing them.
data "redirhub_links" "old_site" {
  handler = "redirect,migration"
  host    = "old.example.com"
}

output "old_site_links" {
  value = { for l in data.redirhub_links.old_site.links : l.url => l.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `handler` (String) Only these handlers, comma-separated: `short-url`, `qr`, `redirect`, `migration`.
- `host` (String) Only links on this hostname.
- `path` (String) Only links on this path: `/` for a hostname's root, `*` for the link that answers every other path.
- `search` (String) Only links whose URL, destination or title contains this text.
- `status` (String) Only `active` or `paused` links; `paused` includes links paused by the plan or its visit limit.
- `tags` (Set of String) Only links with any of these tags.

### Read-Only

- `links` (List of Object) The matching links. `status` is as the API reports it, e.g. `active`, `paused` or `dns_incorrect`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--links))
